notes: C4 has no qualifying primary because the command enters through a bus-request record field and then traverses FIFO write/read-data signals, which the stated FIFO and bus-record bars exclude.
C8 treats onewire_i as the primary boundary value; serial.wire_in and bus_rsp_o.data are forwarding and response-record carriers rather than independent primaries.
